result.stdout:
USAGE: mig <command> [options]

Commands:
  codegen   Generate F# modules from an annotated schema directory
  version   Print version and exit
  help      Show this help

codegen options:
  -m, --migrations <dir>   Schema directory (snapshot *.sql + optional _migration.sql)
  -o, --output <dir>       Output directory for generated modules (required)
  -n, --namespace <name>   F# namespace prefix, e.g. MyApp.Db (required)
